name: tessl-labs/factory-setup
description: Set up, understand, and change a Tessl factory on a repository: pick automations that fit how you work, such as shipping tickets as pull requests, answering reviews and fixing checks on those pull requests, code review, and scheduled jobs; prepare the repository for agents; write issues for the factory to build; then see what the factory has done, find out why a run failed or never started, and change or extend it.
